newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Eurobond road-show to take place March 11,1.
newsitem.headline: Russia Eurobond road-show to take place March 11,1.

text.p: Russia will present its second Eurobond at road-shows on March 11 and 12 in Zurich and Frankfurt respectively, a Finance Ministry official said on Thursday.
The mark Eurobond itself will probably be launched on March 13, foreign credits department deputy head Vladimir Dmitriyev told Reuters.

The volume will be between 1.5 and two billion marks, a senior Deutsche Bank AG official said last week. The bond is being lead-managed by Deutsche's investment banking division Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, and CS First Boston.
Russia hopes to raise up to $3 billion through Eurobonds in different currencies this year.
